_comment: Settings of the three Railway services, to enter in the dashboard (or send with serviceInstanceUpdate / `railway environment edit --service-config`, unverified). Not read by Railway: Config as Code is deprecated and new services cannot use it. Key names follow the former railway.json deploy section; memory is in bytes. The adapter test checks these values.

api.preDeployCommand: sh -c 'node dist/init-bucket.js && node dist/migrate.js && node dist/seed.js'
